# Download BARL — Broadcast Assistant for Rocket League

> Direct download page for BARL, a free Windows desktop application providing a Rocket League broadcasting overlay with automated series score, real-time boost meters, and customizable team branding. Download the installer and join the Discord for setup instructions.

## Download

- [BARL Download Page](https://lndrlndr.github.io/BARL_App/): Download the latest BARL installer (.exe for Windows)
- [BARL Discord](https://discord.gg/qF5FkJxNdR): Support, download assistance, and community

## Optional

- [BARL Feature Overview](https://lndrlndr.github.io/BARL-Overlay/): Full feature documentation for BARL
- [BARL Product Page](https://lndrlndr.github.io/BARL/): Detailed feature list with video demonstrations
